39: // FmtCommand is a Command implementation that rewrites Terraform config
40: // files to a canonical format and style.
41: type FmtCommand struct {
42: 	Meta
43: 	list      bool
44: 	write     bool
45: 	diff      bool
46: 	check     bool
47: 	recursive bool
48: 	input     io.Reader // STDIN if nil
49: }
50: 
51: func (c *FmtCommand) Run(args []string) int {
52: 	if c.input == nil {
53: 		c.input = os.Stdin
54: 	}
55: 
56: 	args = c.Meta.process(args)
57: 	cmdFlags := c.Meta.defaultFlagSet("fmt")
58: 	cmdFlags.BoolVar(&c.list, "list", true, "list")
59: 	cmdFlags.BoolVar(&c.write, "write", true, "write")
60: 	cmdFlags.BoolVar(&c.diff, "diff", false, "diff")
61: 	cmdFlags.BoolVar(&c.check, "check", false, "check")
62: 	cmdFlags.BoolVar(&c.recursive, "recursive", false, "recursive")
63: 	cmdFlags.Usage = func() { c.Ui.Error(c.Help()) }
64: 	if err := cmdFlags.Parse(args); err != nil {
65: 		c.Ui.Error(fmt.Sprintf("Error parsing command-line flags: %s\n", err.Error()))
66: 		return 1
67: 	}
68: 
69: 	args = cmdFlags.Args()
70: 
71: 	var paths []string
72: 	if len(args) == 0 {
73: 		paths = []string{"."}
74: 	} else if args[0] == stdinArg {
75: 		c.list = false
76: 		c.write = false
77: 	} else {
78: 		paths = args
79: 	}
80: 
81: 	var output io.Writer
82: 	list := c.list // preserve the original value of -list
83: 	if c.check {
84: 		// set to true so we can use the list output to check
85: 		// if the input needs formatting
86: 		c.list = true
87: 		c.write = false
88: 		output = &bytes.Buffer{}
89: 	} else {
90: 		output = &cli.UiWriter{Ui: c.Ui}
91: 	}
92: 
93: 	diags := c.fmt(paths, c.input, output)
94: 	c.showDiagnostics(diags)
95: 	if diags.HasErrors() {
96: 		return 2
97: 	}
98: 
99: 	if c.check {
100: 		buf := output.(*bytes.Buffer)
101: 		ok := buf.Len() == 0
102: 		if list {
103: 			io.Copy(&cli.UiWriter{Ui: c.Ui}, buf)
104: 		}
105: 		if ok {
106: 			return 0
107: 		} else {
108: 			return 3
109: 		}
110: 	}
111: 
112: 	return 0
113: }

115: func (c *FmtCommand) fmt(paths []string, stdin io.Reader, stdout io.Writer) tfdiags.Diagnostics {
116: 	var diags tfdiags.Diagnostics
117: 
118: 	stdinMode := false
119: 	targets := paths
120: 	if len(paths) == 0 {
121: 		if c.write {
122: 			diags = diags.Append(fmt.Errorf("Option -write cannot be used when reading from stdin"))
123: 			return diags
124: 		}
125: 		stdinMode = true
126: 		targets = []string{"<stdin>"}
127: 	}
128: 
129: 	for _, path := range targets {
130: 		var jobs []struct {
131: 			name   string
132: 			reader io.Reader
133: 			closer io.Closer
134: 		}
135: 
136: 		if stdinMode {
137: 			jobs = append(jobs, struct {
138: 				name   string
139: 				reader io.Reader
140: 				closer io.Closer
141: 			}{name: "<stdin>", reader: stdin})
142: 		}
143: 
144: 		if !stdinMode {
145: 			if c.WorkingDir == nil {
146: 				log.Printf("[WARN] This 'Meta' object is missing its WorkingDir, so we're creating a default one suitable only for tests")
147: 				c.WorkingDir = workdir.NewDir(".")
148: 			}
149: 			absMain, absErr := filepath.Abs(c.WorkingDir.RootModuleDir())
150: 			if absErr != nil {
151: 				path = filepath.Clean(path)
152: 			} else {
153: 				given := path
154: 				if !filepath.IsAbs(given) {
155: 					given = filepath.Join(absMain, given)
156: 				}
157: 				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(absMain, given)
158: 				if relErr != nil {
159: 					path = filepath.Clean(given)

163: 			}

165: 			info, err := os.Stat(path)
166: 			if err != nil {

168: 				return diags
169: 			}
170: 
171: 			if info.IsDir() {
172: 				frames := []struct {
173: 					path    string
174: 					entries []os.FileInfo
175: 					index   int
176: 					loaded  bool
177: 				}{{path: path}}
178: 				for len(frames) > 0 {
179: 					frame := &frames[len(frames)-1]
180: 					if !frame.loaded {
181: 						log.Printf("[TRACE] terraform fmt: looking for files in %s", frame.path)
182: 						entries, readErr := ioutil.ReadDir(frame.path)
183: 						if readErr != nil {

191: 						}
192: 						frame.entries = entries
193: 						frame.index = 0

195: 					}
196: 					if frame.index >= len(frame.entries) {

199: 					}
200: 					entry := frame.entries[frame.index]
201: 					frame.index++
202: 					name := entry.Name()
203: 					if strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {

205: 					}
206: 					if strings.HasSuffix(name, "~") {
207: 						continue
208: 					}

213: 					}

221: 								loaded  bool
222: 							}{path: subPath})
223: 						}

229: 							if openErr != nil {
230: 								diags = diags.Append(fmt.Errorf("Failed to read file %s", subPath))

232: 							}

240: 					}
241: 				}
242: 			} else {

247: 						if openErr != nil {
248: 							diags = diags.Append(fmt.Errorf("Failed to read file %s", path))
249: 							continue
250: 						}
251: 						jobs = append(jobs, struct {

256: 						fmtd = true

259: 				}
260: 				if !fmtd {
261: 					diags = diags.Append(fmt.Errorf("Only .tf, .tfvars, and .tftest.hcl files can be processed with terraform fmt"))

265: 		}

269: 			src, readErr := ioutil.ReadAll(job.reader)
270: 			if job.closer != nil {
